items.title: Stocks in news: Waaree Energies, PB Fintech, Lemon Tree Hotels and Dr Lal PathLabs
items.description: Indian equity markets saw significant declines, with the NSE Nifty 50 index dropping by over 380 points. PB Fintech experienced a sharp 36% plunge after regulatory changes. Waaree Energies expanded into the specialty gases business to supply semiconductor manufacturers. Dr Lal PathLabs approved the acquisition of a majority stake in SN Genelab Private Ltd. Several companies, including JSW Cement, faced regulatory scrutiny amid ongoing market fluctuations.

items.title: D-Street poised for positive start as GIFT Nifty signals gains
items.description: Benchmark Nifty declined by 1.6% due to rising global uncertainties and elevated crude prices. Analysts predict weakness in Indian equities amid geopolitical tensions and market fluctuations. The immediate support level for the index is identified at 23,000, with resistance at 23,200. Foreign portfolio investors sold shares worth Rs 5,027 crore, while domestic investors bought shares worth Rs 4,201 crore. The rupee also weakened against the US dollar amid these developments.

items.title: Dalal Street slumps on oil spike, bond rout & Irda jolt
items.description: The US 10-year Treasury yield moved above 5.10%, while Brent crude remained above $102 a barrel, raising concerns over global liquidity, inflation and India's import bill.

items.title: NSE becomes world's sixth largest bourse with $47 billion m-cap
items.description: The National Stock Exchange of India has recently reached an impressive market capitalisation nearing $47 billion. Shares began trading at ₹1,800, slightly above the issue price of ₹1,785. With a price-to-earnings ratio of 43 times, it outperforms many global exchanges. Experts predict a strong growth in India’s capital markets, estimating an annual cash market turnover increase of 14-16%. Additionally, NSE's operating Ebitda margin of 66.

items.title: Lower commissions could push Policybazaar into insurance manufacturing: Yashish Dahiya
items.description: PB Fintech is evaluating the possibility of entering insurance manufacturing as distribution commissions may decrease significantly. The proposed commission caps by the Insurance Regulatory Authority of India could impact the economic viability of their current distribution model. While these changes might make manufacturing more attractive, the company emphasizes the need for regulatory clarity. Additionally, PB Fintech believes its large customer base may provide an advantage if it enters manufacturing.

items.title: Reliance to raise Rs 10,000 crore next week as companies rush to tap surplus bank liquidity
items.description: Reliance Industries Limited is planning to raise ₹10,000 crore next week through a ten-year maturity bond. Other firms, including Adani Airport Holdings, will raise significant funds as well this Friday. The increasing number of companies tapping debt indicates the surplus liquidity in the banking system. This trend is occurring ahead of the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy decision on October 7.

items.title: Irdai commission curbs spark sharp selloff in insurers, banks and NBFCs
items.description: Shares of insurers, banks, and non-banking finance companies dropped sharply following proposed commission caps by Irdai. The proposals raised concerns over the outlook for businesses reliant on insurance distribution. Major companies such as PB Fintech and Max Financial Services experienced significant declines. Analysts indicate that banks and NBFCs could face negative impacts from the changes in commission structures.

items.title: Credit card spending falls 2.8% in August as new card additions slow
items.description: In August, credit card spending decreased by 2.8% to ₹2.02 lakh crore from July's ₹2.08 lakh crore. While year-on-year spending saw an increase of 5.9% compared to August 2025, the trend indicates moderation. Additionally, banks added 1.19 million new credit cards, down 5.6% from July's figures. This brings the total credit card tally to 124.1 million at the month's end.

items.title: IRDAI proposes clawback of commissions in case of mis-selling
items.description: Under the proposed framework, distributors could be rewarded for the quality of sales and servicing, while commissions could be clawed back in cases of mis-selling. The regulator has also proposed greater accountability for individual sales staff by tagging their identity to policies sold and putting information on mis-selling incidents in the public domain.

items.title: How to trade PB Fintech shares after falling 12% from day’s high? This technical analyst explains
items.description: PB Fintech shares extended their sharp selloff on Friday, falling 5% after plunging 36% in the previous session. Technical analysts flagged weak momentum, broken support levels and bearish indicators, while brokerages lowered targets or retained cautious views amid concerns over proposed IRDAI changes and their potential impact on Policybazaar’s earnings.

items.title: Balrampur Chini Mills shares rally 4% as company receives Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant from government
items.description: Balrampur Chini Mills shares gained after the government awarded a Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant for a 100 TPA PLA co-polymer R&D facility at its Kumbhi manufacturing complex in Uttar Pradesh.

items.title: Jefferies is bullish on Adani Ports and 5 other logistics sector stocks. How many do you have?
items.description: Jefferies said Indian port volumes rose 7% YoY in August 2026, driven by government-owned Major Ports. Indian Railways’ container volumes, however, declined 3% YoY, compared with a 10% YoY increase in port container volumes, which the brokerage attributed to Middle-East tensions. items.title: OFSS shares tumble 5% after Oracle sends 'force majeure' notice for data centre project. Are AI worries coming true?
items.description: Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS) shares tumbled over 5% after parent company Oracle issued a force majeure notice regarding a massive New Mexico AI data centre project. The development triggered financing concerns across AI infrastructure, sending OFSS stock to a nine-week low of Rs 10,332 on the NSE.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Welspun Corp shares rise 4% after US subsidiary bags $412.5 million HFIW pipe order
items.description: Welspun Corp shares rose after its US subsidiary secured a record $412.5 million HFIW pipe order, lifting its global order book to $4.7 billion and strengthening its US manufacturing footprint.

items.title: Sensex rebounds a day after crash, Nifty above 23,050. Where is D-Street headed?
items.description: Nifty’s short-term structure has weakened significantly after the break below the previous seven-day lows and the 23,070 swing-low zone, accompanied by rising volumes, said Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst at Choice Broking Private. He sees the benchmark index finding immediate support at 22,800–23,000, while resistance is seen at 23,250–23,300.

items.title: Ola Electric shares tumble 9% after 17% rally in 4 days. Why brokerages remain cautious
items.description: Ola Electric shares fell sharply on Friday, snapping a four-day winning streak as investors assessed the EV maker’s proposed rights issue and ongoing funding needs. Despite a recent recovery, the stock remains well below its peak. Brokerages including Citi and Kotak continue to maintain bearish views, citing operational and cash-burn concerns.

items.title: Tata Sons boardroom battle intensifies but Tata Group stocks remain unbothered. Should you buy?
items.description: Tata Sons has rejected Noel Tata’s objections to N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment, saying the board’s decision was valid and made in accordance with the company’s Articles of Association.

items.title: 800% gains, 106 multibaggers in 3 years; now every second Nifty 500 stock is down in 2026. Time for caution?
items.description: After a three-year rally featuring 106 multibaggers, over half of the Nifty 500 stocks are down in 2026 amid $30 billion in FII outflows and geopolitical risks. As broader market valuations stretch, analysts advise caution, with leading fund managers highlighting better risk-reward comfort in largecap equities.

items.title: PB Fintech's 36% bloodbath rattles market, but Jefferies stays bullish. What does it see in Policybazaar parent?
items.description: PB Fintech shares plunged a record 36% to a 52-week low, wiping out around Rs 31,430 crore in market value after IRDAI proposed changes to insurance commission structures. While Jefferies flagged a potentially material near-term earnings impact, it retained its ‘Buy’ call on the stock.

items.title: Meesho shares can fall 28%, warns Nomura after initiating coverage with Reduce call. Here is why
items.description: Shares of Meesho dropped up to 5% to Rs 221 after Nomura initiated coverage with a Reduce rating and a Rs 167 target price, citing a 28% downside risk. The brokerage highlighted valuation concerns, rising competition from quick commerce, and margin headwinds despite liking Meesho's asset-light model.

items.title: ICICI Lombard General Insurance among 3 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.description: On September 24, three stocks with a market capitalisation of over Rs 10,000 crore featured in the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis in which the opening price is the lowest, and the closing price is the highest for a given period. The pattern is represented by a long white or green candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow, reflecting strong upward price movement during the session.

items.title: PB Fintech among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 24, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 7% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: PB Fintech shares slip another 5% after massive 36% crash on Thursday. What are Jefferies, others saying?
items.description: PB Fintech share price: PB Fintech shares plunged 36% in the previous session following IRDAI’s proposal to curb ‘dark patterns’ on insurance websites. The proposed rules could also pressure insurance stocks by limiting insurers’ Expense of Management (EoM), potentially reducing spending on commissions and distribution while raising customer acquisition costs.

items.title: Chalet Hotels among 3 stocks closed above VWAP
items.description: On September 24, the closing prices of three Nifty500 stocks were more than 1% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When a stock closes above its VWAP, it means it ended the session at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price. VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.
